baseline.family: league-specific Dirichlet-smoothed empirical P(D|T) from development rows only, pooled-T fallback
baseline.support: all parity-legal D values from -T to +T

proper_score_pass: paired match-bootstrap 90% CI upper bound for conditional LogLoss < 0
frozen_gate.decision: PASS only if proper_score_pass and top1_support all pass; otherwise FAIL/PARK without retuning on the 20000 labels
